summary.text: Wendy Thomas is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was previously executive director of the New Hampshire Challenge and served in the House from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Thomas was born in Fairfield, Connecticut, and lives in Merrimack, New Hampshire.
She earned a B.A. in English, chemistry and biology from the University of Connecticut in 1981 and an instructional design certificate from San Diego State University in 1992.
Her career experience includes working as executive director of the New Hampshire Challenge, a freelance writer and journalist, and a patient liaison.
Thomas represented Hillsborough 21 in the New Hampshire House from 2018 to 2020 and returned in 2022, representing Hillsborough 12 since that election, according to Ballotpedia.
She was assigned to the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee for the 2019-2020 session and to the Science, Technology and Energy Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
